```{python}
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

csv_path = "/media/tony/Drive2/Programs/librarian/later_list.csv"

try:
    df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("No projects in vault.")
    quit()

if df.empty:
    print("No projects saved.")
    quit()

# Calculate aging
df['Date Added'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date Added'])
df['Days Active'] = (datetime.now() - df['Date Added']).dt.days

def aging_status(days):
    if days > 60: return "🔴 High (Archive?)"
    if days > 30: return "🟡 Medium (Review)"
    return "🟢 Fresh"

df['Aging'] = df['Days Active'].apply(aging_status)

print("## 📋 Project Vault Report\n")
print(f"Total projects: {len(df)}\n")

# Stale projects (30+ days)
stale = df[df['Days Active'] > 30]
if not stale.empty:
    print("### ⚠️ Stale Projects (30+ days)\n")
    for _, row in stale.sort_values('Days Active', ascending=False).iterrows():
        print(f"- **{row['Project Name']}** ({row['Days Active']} days)")
        print(f"  - Stack: {row['Stack']}")
        print(f"  - Status: {row['Status']}")
        print()

# Fresh projects
fresh = df[df['Days Active'] <= 30]
if not fresh.empty:
    print("### 🟢 Fresh Projects\n")
    for _, row in fresh.iterrows():
        print(f"- **{row['Project Name']}** ({row['Days Active']} days)")
        print(f"  - Stack: {row['Stack']}")
        print()
```
